verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no payroll preview API, anomaly detection, or agent-driven approval workflow—only manual UI-based payroll accuracy checks (Analytics > Custom Payroll Report) and unrelated integration/onboarding docs. A brief mention of a Justworks MCP exists but with no detail confirming payroll-run preview or anomaly-surfacing capability, and API probes (openapi/llms.txt) returned 404s. Missing for 10: any API endpoint for payroll preview, anomaly-detection logic, or agent-approval workflow documentation.
